description: Get someone from safe merchant solutions to contact you. At least one of these is required: what_is_your_phone_number_include_country_code, can_you_provide_your_whatsapp_or_telegram_for_easier_communicati. Ask for the others as well and include any the visitor is happy to give — only the group as a whole is mandatory, so never refuse to submit over one they declined.

can_you_provide_your_whatsapp_or_telegra.description: Can you provide your whatsapp or telegram for easier communication? Always offer this, even after what_is_your_phone_number_include_country_code has been given — at that point it is optional, so take it if the visitor is willing and move on if they are not.

what_is_your_phone_number_include_countr.description: What is your phone number ? (include country code) Always offer this, even after can_you_provide_your_whatsapp_or_telegram_for_easier_communicati has been given — at that point it is optional, so take it if the visitor is willing and move on if they are not.
